cohort: The study included 40 women with spontaneous preterm birth (24-31 weeks gestation) and 40 women with spontaneous term birth (37-41 weeks gestation) admitted to the University of Malaya Medical Centre from 2011 to 2013.
finding: Six specific cytokines (TNFA, MCP-3, IL16, IL17A, IFNG, and farctalkine) were found to be significantly elevated among women with spontaneous preterm birth.
gest_age: Spontaneous preterm birth: 24-31 weeks; Spontaneous term birth: 37-41 weeks
